text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is a mock race in racewear,
simulating a real GⅠ.
It's a rare and precious opportunity, but—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mejiro Ardan's Trainer...
I was just checking the turf, and with the rain until recently,
the ground is totally heavy.
choice_data_list: Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The temperature has dropped quite a bit, so
I'm thinking of passing on it.
It certainly is an important opportunity, but...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Your trainee... if I recall, isn't she naturally
not very physically strong?
I advise you to exercise careful judgment. ...Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer.
I overheard the word... "decline".
choice_data_list: Yeah, looks like they were worried about me.
Yeah, it seems she was worried about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see... It's truly wonderful
to have people looking out for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Whether to scratch from the race or not...
...Trainer, could you make the call?
choice_data_list: Is it okay for me to decide?
Is it okay for me to decide?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with pleasure.
—I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I ponder for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she runs, the experience gained will be substantial.
She's in good shape from warm-ups too,
so there's no reason to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, what if she's hiding an ailment...?
Just to be safe, I check in with
Mejiro Ardan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
If it means running in "this very moment."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Without a doubt,
we will be able to give it our absolute all.
I can assert that with certainty."
choice_data_list: Okay... Then let's run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure about this?
choice_data_list: Because I believe in "this moment" that Aldan spoke of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
In that case, I will give it my all so I have no regrets.
choice_data_list: Yeah, do your best!
Yeah, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Blending in with the Umamusume in their racewear like this
brings back memories...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(—Come to think of it, quite a lot of time passed
between completing my physical maturation
and finally wearing my racing silks.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Adorned in their proud racing silks,
the Umamusume are now loading into the gates!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It's beautiful...
Thank you for bringing me here,
Nanny.

text_block_list.name: Ardan's Nanny
text_block_list.text:
No.
However, you were only recently discharged from the hospital, so please try not to overexert yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
I am well aware.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...Just when will the day come
when I can wear that pride, that light...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I will definitely wear it. I swore I would, but I'd be lying if I said I wasn't envious. ...And then—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a resounding clatter, the gates burst open.
The overcast air hangs heavy,
yet the hem of her racing silks billows brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And now—
wearing this outfit, I run!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(You were the one who gave me this chance.
If so, this outfit is proof that you believed in me and sent me out here.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I want to be someone worthy...
of wearing that pride, that light!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... haa.
I ended up... losing...!
choice_data_list: Good work! ...You ended up covered in mud.
Good work! ...You ended up covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Fufu, that's true.
Even though our clothes got all dirty...
choice_data_list: That's the first step toward victory.
That's the first step toward victory, isn't it?
However...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Fufu, that's true.
Even though our clothes got all dirty...
choice_data_list: That's the first step toward victory.
That's the first step toward victory, isn't it?
However...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
! ...Ufufu.
I was thinking the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall engrave this defeat deep into my heart.
Yet, the fact that I was able to run in 'this' very moment, and face the challenge without running away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This experience will surely serve as nourishment.
I shall push forward even further.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you very much
for believing in me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
From now on...
I look forward to continuing to work with you.
choice_data_list: Same here, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to live up to her trust and be someone she can truly rely on...
Today was a day that made me feel that all over again!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Somehow—
I feel so refreshed and bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even covered in mud, even drenched to the bone...
I was able to keep running.
All because you believed in me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer?
From here on out...
I might not be able to stop very easily.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do our best again next time!
Yeah, let's keep doing our best next time, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, gladly!
